title: Guard against removing last type in `remove_type`

text: Acceptance: `remove_type` returns `AppError::Validation` with a message containing "last" when called with the only remaining type in types.toml. New unit test `remove_type_rejects_last_type` passes. Files: `src/storage.rs` (guard clause in `remove_type` at line 441 + new test after line 1210)
